items.stem: A sales team promises 2 ms one-way across 1,145 km of fiber. What do you say?
choices: Impossible; propagation alone is about 5.6 ms

items.stem: Upgrading a link from 1 to 10 Gbit/s reduces which part of a 1,145 km budget?
Two engineers write 2001:DB8:0:0:1::1 and 2001:db8::1:0:0:1 for the same address. Which is canonical?
A customer asks for a /72 on a LAN to save space. Your answer?
choices: Keep LANs at /64; autoconfiguration expects it

items.stem: A long-haul transfer stalls at 6 Mbit/s on a 1 Gbit/s link. First check?
choices: TCP window scaling on both hosts and middleboxes

items.stem: Why does a 200 ms path need a larger window than a 20 ms path at the same rate?
choices: The bandwidth-delay product is ten times larger

items.stem: A route has the shortest AS_PATH but loses. Most likely reason?
choices: Another route has higher local preference

items.stem: Why is local preference above AS_PATH in the order?
choices: It encodes the operator's own policy

items.stem: A cutover is planned for tomorrow and the TTL is one day. What should you have done?
choices: Lowered the TTL at least a day earlier

items.stem: Why keep old servers running after a DNS change?
choices: Resolvers can serve the old answer for up to one TTL

items.stem: The origin link is near capacity at a 92% hit ratio. Highest-leverage fix?
choices: Raise the hit ratio; misses drive origin load

items.stem: A report says 'the CDN offloads 92%, so origin sees 11,040 rps of 12,000'. What is wrong?
choices: It multiplied by the hit ratio instead of the miss ratio

items.stem: A span measures 4 dB worse than budget. Likely first cause?
Why require 3 dB of optical margin?
choices: Ageing, temperature, and repair splices add loss over time

items.stem: Both core routers share one power strip. What does that do to the availability estimate?
choices: It is overstated; failures are not independent

items.stem: The serial power feed dominates downtime. Most effective investment?
A provider bills the month's peak sample under a 95th-percentile contract. What do you do?
choices: Dispute it with the sorted samples and index

items.stem: Why does 95th-percentile billing reward scheduling backups at quiet times?
choices: Short bursts in the top 5% are not billed
Night traffic is free by law

items.stem: A design packet uses AS 13335 and 2606:4700::/32. Verdict?
choices: Reject; those are real allocations, not documentation

items.stem: Which statement belongs in every backbone design packet in this course?
Which public reference governs the TCP window scale option?
Which use of Cisco CCNA material is acceptable here?
choices: Topic labels only, no exam items

items.stem: A packet restates last term's availability figure without inputs. What should the reviewer do?
choices: Ask for the recomputation from inputs

items.stem: What does completing the Backbone Room course claim?
choices: Infrastructure practice with recomputed labs, not a certification or production role
